message.content:
Here are some of the most popular books written by J.K. Rowling:

| Title | Year Published |
|-------|----------------|
| *Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone* (also known as *Sorcerer’s Stone* in the U.S.) | 1997 |
| *Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets* | 1998 |
| *Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban* | 1999 |
| *Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire* | 2000 |
| *Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix* | 2003 |
| *Harry Potter and the Half‑Blood Prince* | 2005 |
| *Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows* | 2007 |
| *Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them* (companion book) | 2001 |
| *Quidditch Through the Ages* (companion book) | 2001 |
| *The Tales of Beedle the Bard* (companion book) | 2008 |
| *The Casual Vacancy* (adult novel) | 2012 |

These titles have sold millions of copies worldwide and have been adapted into blockbuster films, making them some of the best‑selling books ever.
